description: This Swift source file defines the `WorkActivityStore` class, a singleton observable object that manages and tracks the current work activities, including jobs and tools, within an application. It handles session states, activity updates, icon state derivation, and interactions with other components related to activity monitoring.

classes.name: WorkActivityStore
classes.description: A singleton class that stores and manages ongoing work activities, including jobs and tools, tracks current session, and derives visual icon states based on activity.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: A struct representing an individual work activity with details such as session key, role, kind, label, start time, and last update timestamp.

methods.name: handleJob
methods.description: Handles state updates for job activities based on session key and state string.

methods.name: handleTool
methods.description: Handles state updates for tool activities, including starting and ending phases, with label and metadata management.

methods.name: resolveIconState
methods.description: Determines the icon state based on an override selection, adapting visual indicators accordingly.

methods.name: setMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets and trims the main session key used as a primary activity reference.
